en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view over a riverside town surrounded by fields and scattered houses. A river runs horizontally through the middle of the image, with small industrial buildings and smoke visible on the far bank. In the foreground are wooden houses, a church‑like building, open farmland, and trees. At the bottom of the image, white printed caption text identifies the scene.
